1945 WORLD News § Italian partisans kill Benito Mussolini After destroying major cities in Germany, Hitler commits suicide. WWII comes to an end, May 8 in Europe, and Aug. 14 in the Pacific, after involving 57 nations. 55 million people died. Soviet troops liberate prisoners of the concentration camp at Auschwitz. Several million people died during the course of the Holocaust, both in and out of German camps. The American flag is raised over Iwo Jima. United Nations convenes with representatives from 51 nations. SeekPublishing Remember When 1945
